transcript.en: Hi Alex. It’s Martha Clines here.
transcript.zh: 嗨,亚历克斯。我是玛莎·克莱恩。

transcript.en: James White gave me your number.
transcript.zh: 詹姆斯·怀特给了我你的电话号码。

transcript.en: I hope you don’t mind me calling you.
transcript.zh: 你应该不介意我给你打电话吧。

transcript.en: Of course not. How are you, Martha?
transcript.zh: 当然不会。你好吗？玛莎。

transcript.en: Good thanks.
transcript.zh: 好的谢谢。

transcript.en: I’m ringing because I need a bit of advice.
transcript.zh: 我打电话是因为我需要一些建议。

transcript.en: Oh yeah. What about?
transcript.zh: 哦，好的，关于什么方面的呢？

transcript.en: The training you did at JPNW a few years ago.
transcript.zh: 几年前你在JPNW做的培训。

transcript.en: I’m applying for the same thing.
transcript.zh: 我也在申请相同的项目。

transcript.en: Oh right Yes, I did mine in 2014. Best thing I ever did，I’m still working there.
transcript.zh: 哦，是的，我在2014年做的。这是我做过的最棒的事，我还在那里工作。

transcript.en: Really? What are you doing?
transcript.zh: 真的吗?你在做什么?

transcript.en: Well, now I work in the customer services department
transcript.zh: 嗯，我现在在客户服务部门工作，

transcript.en: but I did my initial training in Finance.
transcript.zh: 但是我最初是接受金融方面的培训。

transcript.en: I stayed there for the first two years and then moved to where I am now.
transcript.zh: 我在那里呆了两年，然后搬到现在的地方。

transcript.en: That’s the same department I’m applying for.
transcript.zh: 那就是我要申请的部门，

transcript.en: Did you enjoy it?
transcript.zh: 你喜欢这份工作吗?

transcript.en: I was pretty nervous to begin with.
transcript.zh: 一开始我是很紧张。

transcript.en: I didn’t do well in my exams at school and I was really worried because I failed Maths.
transcript.zh: 我在学校的考试成绩不好，我真的很担心，因为我数学不及格。

transcript.en: But it didn’t actually matter because I did lots of courses on the job.
transcript.zh: 但这并不重要，因为我在工作上又学了很多课程。

transcript.en: Did you get a diploma at the end of your trainee period?
transcript.zh: 你在实习结束后拿到文凭了吗?

transcript.en: I’m hoping to do the one in business skills.
transcript.zh: 我希望拿到商业技能文凭。

transcript.en: Yes. That sounds good.
transcript.zh: 是的。听起来不错。

transcript.en: I took the one on IT skills but I wish I’d done that one instead.
transcript.zh: 我选的是IT技能，但我希望我能选那个。

transcript.en: OK, that’s good to know.
transcript.zh: 那也挺好的。

transcript.en: What about the other trainees? How did you get on with them?
transcript.zh: 其他学员呢?你和他们相处得怎样?

transcript.en: There were about 20 of us who started at the same time and we were all around the same age -
transcript.zh: 我们大约有20个人同时开始，我们都差不多大——

transcript.en: I was 18 and there was only one person younger than me, who was 17.
transcript.zh: 我18岁，只有一个比我小的人，17岁。

transcript.en: The rest were between 18 and 20.
transcript.zh: 其余的人年龄在18到20岁之间。

transcript.en: I made some good friends.
transcript.zh: 我也交了一些好朋友。

transcript.en: I’ve heard lots of good things about the training at JPNW.
transcript.zh: 我听说了很多关于JPNW培训的好处。

transcript.en: It seems like there are a lot of opportunities there.
transcript.zh: 这样子说来那里有很多机会。

transcript.en: Yeah, definitely. Because of its size you can work in loads of different areas within the organisation.
transcript.zh: 是的,当然。由于它的规模，你可以在组织内不同的领域工作。

transcript.en: What about pay?
transcript.zh: 工资怎么样?

transcript.en: I know you get a lower minimum wage than regular employees.
transcript.zh: 我知道你的最低工资比普通员工还低。

transcript.en: That’s right - which isn’t great.
transcript.zh: 是的，这并不是很好。

transcript.en: But you get the same number of days’ holiday as everyone else.
transcript.zh: 但是你的假期和其他人一样多。

transcript.en: And the pay goes up massively if they offer you a job at the end of the training period.
transcript.zh: 如果你在实习结束时获得一份正式工作，那么你的工资就会大幅上涨。

transcript.en: Yeah, but I’m not doing it for the money – it’s the experience I think will be really useful.
transcript.zh: 好的，但我不是为了钱才这么做的——我是冲着有用的实习经验去的。

transcript.en: Everyone says by the end of the year you gain so much confidence.
transcript.zh: 每个人都说在年底结束的时候，你会信心大增。

transcript.en: You’re right. That’s the most useful part about it.
transcript.zh: 是的。这也是最有用的部分。

transcript.en: There’s a lot of variety too. You’re given lots of different things to do.
transcript.zh: 这里也有很多变化，你有机会尝试各种各样不同的东西。

transcript.en: I enjoyed it all - I didn’t even mind the studying.
transcript.zh: 我喜欢这一切——我甚至不介意学习。

transcript.en: Do you have to spend any time in college?
transcript.zh: 你必须在大学里待一段时间吗?

transcript.en: Yes, one day each month.
transcript.zh: 是的，每个月一天，

transcript.en: So you get lots of support from both your tutor and your manager.
transcript.zh: 所以你会从导师和经理那里获得很多支持。

transcript.en: That’s good. And the company is easy to get to, isn’t it?
transcript.zh: 很好耶。这样子公司也很容易找到，不是吗?

transcript.en: Yes, it’s very close to the train station so the location’s a real advantage.
transcript.zh: 是的，它离火车站很近，所以公司的地理位置真的非常好。

transcript.en: Have you got a date for your interview yet?
transcript.zh: 你面试的日期确定下来了吗？

transcript.en: Yes, it’s on the 23rd of this month.
transcript.zh: 嗯嗯，就在本月23日。

transcript.en: So long as you’re well prepared there’s nothing to worry about.
transcript.zh: 只要你准备充分，就没有什么可担心的。

transcript.en: Everyone’s very friendly.
transcript.zh: 每个人都很友好。

transcript.en: I am not sure what I should wear. What do you think?
transcript.zh: 我不知道该穿什么。你觉得呢?

transcript.en: Nothing too casual - like Jeans, for example.
transcript.zh: 不要穿太随意的衣服，比如牛仔裤。

transcript.en: If you’ve got a nice jacket, wear that with a skirt or trousers.
transcript.zh: 如果你有一件漂亮的外套，那就再配一条裙子或一条裤子。

transcript.en: OK. Thanks. Any other tips?
transcript.zh: 好的，感谢。还有什么其它建议吗？

transcript.en: Erm, well I know it’s really obvious but arrive in plenty of time.
transcript.zh: 嗯，还有一个就是要提前很多时间到场，

transcript.en: They hate people who are late.
transcript.zh: 他们讨厌迟到的人。

transcript.en: So make sure you know exactly where you have to get to.
transcript.zh: 所以一定要提前弄清楚你要去哪里？

transcript.en: And one other useful piece of advice my manager told me before I had the interview for this job - is to smile.
transcript.zh: 我面试这份工作之前，我的经理告诉我的另一个有用的建议—微笑。

transcript.en: Even if you feel terrified. It makes people respond better to you.
transcript.zh: 即使你感到害怕。微笑会让人对你有一个更好的反应。

transcript.en: I’ll have to practise doing that in the mirror!
transcript.zh: 我得在镜子里练习微笑！

transcript.en: Yeah - well, good luck.
transcript.zh: 好吧，祝你好运。

transcript.en: Let me know if you need any more information.
transcript.zh: 如果你需要更多的信息，请告诉我。

transcript.en: Thanks very much.
transcript.zh: 非常感谢。
